reconcile.note: Adam Clarke argues that the fourth generation of Genesis 15:16 is an elastic, non-literal idiom equivalent to the passage's four hundred years, not a strict four-link genealogy.

sides.snippet: In the fourth generation they will come here again
sides.verseText: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.\"

sides.snippet: Amram took Jochebed his father's sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses
sides.verseText: Amram took Jochebed his father's sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were a hundred and thirty-seven years.
